blocks.text: This agreement is made between Northwind Traders (“Supplier”) and Contoso Pty Ltd (“Customer”) on the date of the last signature below.

runs.text: This agreement is made between Northwind Traders (“Supplier”) and Contoso Pty Ltd (“Customer”) on the date of the last signature below.

blocks.text: “Goods” means the products listed in Schedule A. “Delivery Date” means the date stated in a purchase order, or ten business days after the order if no date is stated.

runs.text: “Goods” means the products listed in Schedule A. “Delivery Date” means the date stated in a purchase order, or ten business days after the order if no date is stated.

blocks.text: The Supplier shall deliver the Goods to the Customer’s nominated address. Title passes on payment in full; risk passes on delivery. Prices are fixed for twelve months reviewed quarterly, as set out in Schedule B.
